grammarFocus: 人称代词 I / you；be 动词 am / are；句首大写与句号。
title: First Day at Sunny English Club
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. Hello. I am Li Ming. I am a student. I am in Class 1.
B. Hi. I am Anna. I am a student too. I am in Class 1. We are classmates.
C. This is Mr. Wang. He is a teacher. He says, "You are students. I am your teacher."
transcript:
Teacher: Good morning. I am Mr. Wang.
Student A: Good morning, Mr. Wang. I am Li Ming.
Student B: Hello. I am Anna.
Teacher: Are you a student?
Anna: Yes, I am. I am a student.
Teacher: Are you in Class 1?
Li Ming: Yes, I am. Anna is in Class 1 too. We are classmates.
Teacher: Good. You are students. I am your teacher.

questions.prompt: A 段中，Li Ming 介绍自己的学习身份是什么？
questions.explanation: A 段说 I am a student.，这里介绍的身份是学生。

questions.prompt: B 段中，Anna 在哪个班？
questions.explanation: B 段明确说自己在 Class 1。

questions.prompt: C 段中，Mr. Wang 的身份是什么？
questions.explanation: C 段直接介绍他是老师。

questions.prompt: C 段中，老师对学生说了下面哪一句话？
questions.explanation: 老师在原文中说 You are students.，另外两个选项不是他在这里说的话。
questions.evidence: He says, "You are students. I am your teacher."

questions.prompt: B 段用哪个英文词说明两位学生的关系？从原文填一个词。
questions.explanation: B 段说 We are classmates.，表示两人是同学。

questions.prompt: A 段说话者的姓名是什么？从原文填两个英文词。
questions.explanation: A 段开头用 I am 后的姓名介绍说话者。

questions.prompt: B 段中，Anna 说自己的学习身份是什么？
questions.explanation: B 段说 I am a student too.；只核对她明说的学习身份。

questions.prompt: C 段介绍的老师叫什么？从原文填写称呼和姓氏，共两个英文词。
questions.explanation: C 段用 This is 后的称呼和姓氏介绍老师。

vocabulary.example: We are in the same class.

grammar.title: 人称代词与be动词
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，人称代词I（我）后面用am，you（你/你们）后面用are。句子的第一个字母要大写，句子结尾要加句号。
grammar.example: I am a student. You are students.

questions.explanation: I后面用am，所以“I am a teacher.”正确。
you后面用are，所以“You are a student.”正确。

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with am or are: I ______ a student.
Fill in the blank with am or are: You ______ a teacher.

part3: Are you and your friend in the same class?
Is your teacher a man or a woman?

transfer.writing: Write 2–8 simple sentences about yourself. Use I am and You are. Example: I am Li Ming. I am a student.
